perks.name: Primary Chain
perks.description: Primary ammo weapon final blows grant a stacking bonus to mobility and Primary weapon range and handling until you are defeated.
perks.exact:
On Primary Ammo Weapon Kill:
Grants a stack of Primary Chain, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.
Stacks are only lost on death.

Primary Chain | +5 Mobility, +5 Range, and +10? Handling for Primary Ammo Weapons per stack.
Maxes out at +15 Mobility, +15 Range, and +30? Handling after scoring 3 Primary Ammo Weapon Kills.

perks.name: Sublime Transit
perks.description: Increases mobility and grants enhanced sprint speed and slide distance.
perks.exact: Passively grants +20 Mobility, increases Sprint Speed from 8 m/s to 8.5m/s, and increases Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters.
